decisions.reason: As a two-component resin injection unit, it fits the firm's long-established plural-component and injection know-how, so absorptive capacity is high and early market withdrawal is unlikely.

This product also builds directly on the firm's core engineering and application knowledge, though having two similar new units slightly raises the chance of later portfolio pruning rather than immediate withdrawal.
An automatic airless spray gun is squarely within the firm's existing spray-application capabilities and customer base, which supports learning, service, and incremental improvement.
A manual airless spray gun is very close to the firm's established gun and coating equipment business, making it one of the safest products to retain.
The air-assisted airless spray gun remains strongly related to the firm's coating technology expertise, with only modest risk if demand proves narrower than for standard airless models.

The data logger is still complementary to the installed equipment base, but it is somewhat farther from the firm's traditional mechanical strengths, so there is more uncertainty about its development and commercial assimilation.
